resources.string: Automated Pronunciation Estimate: Feedback is generated using speech recognition and AI acoustic heuristics, not an official or certified linguistic assessment.
Self-Paced Learning Progress: Proficiency levels and scores reflect in-app study milestones and are not officially certified language exam credentials.

Cloud AI Unavailable Offline: Interna AI cloud conversations require an active internet connection because no local on-device LLM is installed. Offline lessons, saved dictionary entries, flashcards, and quizzes remain fully accessible.
